facts.fact: G3ict's DARE Index 2020 data scores Burundi 0/50 on policies and programs, stating it has no policies in any of ten areas including web, e-government, mobile telephony, assistive technologies and procurement of accessible goods and services.

note: Survey of ICT use in 17 disability centers; no law, policy, government delivery or accessibility audit stated.
Nothing on accessibility for persons with disabilities.
